title: Targeted lighthouse beta operational playbook and GTM cadence
creator: Ayesha Patel
description: Runbook to operationalize a 6-week lighthouse beta with 6–10 strategic accounts. Purpose: validate onboarding path, surface early usability and SLO regressions, coordinate release notes and GTM enablement, and lock success criteria for GA. This ticket captures the sequence of tasks, cross-functional owners, feedback loop, and launch gating conditions.
acceptance_criteria: 3 lighthouse accounts actively sending production-like traffic for at least 2 consecutive weeks
Release notes drafted, peer-reviewed by Docs and Legal, and published to the beta portal at least 48 hours before customer enablement
Ops runbook (incident and rollback) published and validated in tabletop with SRE and Support
Feedback loop closed: >80% of reported issues either triaged or mapped to roadmap items within 5 business days
Quantitative success signals captured on Gaugeboard: average 95th percentile latency < 300ms for 8k token workload, and token error rate < 0.2%
CS/AM enablement completed: 2 walkthrough sessions and one customer-specific onboarding runbook per lighthouse account
tasks: Finalize lighthouse account list and NDAs (CS / Legal) - due 2025-02-07
Create per-account onboarding checklist and initial prompt templates (PM + Solutions Eng) - due 2025-02-12
Coordinate release notes: Draft -> Eng review -> Docs review -> Legal signoff -> Publish (Owners: PM, Docs, Legal) - milestone 2025-02-28
Schedule two-weekly syncs with lighthouse champions and internal stakeholders (SRE, Support, Sales) - recurring
Prepare observability dashboards and alert thresholds (ENG + Observability) - due 2025-02-18
Run tabletop incident playbook with Support and SRE prior to customer enablement - execute by 2025-02-20
Deliver CS enablement (demo recordings, Q&A, troubleshooting notes) - due 2025-02-25
Collect and categorize feedback into: critical bugs, UX polish, docs gaps, feature requests (PM triage) - ongoing
Daily health check for first 72 hours post-enable (SRE on-call + PM) - per-launch
Post-mortem and learnings doc within 5 business days after each major incident (Owner: ENG Lead)
timeline_milestones: 2025-02-12 - Onboarding templates and test prompts finalized
2025-02-24 - Pilot enablement window opens (staggered across accounts)
2025-03-14 - Pilot close: success review and GA gating decision
rollout_steps: 1) Dry-run: internal engineering + CS using customer templates (2 days)
2) Soft enable for first 2 lighthouse accounts (canary) with SRE monitoring (1 week)
3) Expand to remaining accounts in waves of 2, monitor metrics and feedback
4) Lock release notes and public beta messaging after wave 2 completion
5) If any P0/P1 bugs are open at end of pilot, apply rollback policy and schedule an emergency patch window
communication_plan: Internal: Weekly lightning updates in #go-to-market and bi-weekly stakeholder syncs
External: Dedicated beta portal page with release notes, known issues, and support contact
Customer: 1:1 kickoff for each lighthouse account, weekly status emails for first month, monthly business review after pilot
Sales: one-pager with decision criteria for promoting accounts to GA and talking points for early-adopter references
Public: embargoed release notes shared with Field 48 hours before public beta message
feedback_flow: Issue intake: CS ticket (Zendesk) tagged with 'lighthouse' -> PM triage within 24h
Automated telemetry: Gaugeboard dashboards feed into weekly quality digest
Feature requests: logged into product roadmap board and acknowledged to customer within 5 business days
Critical incidents: Pager duty to ENG + SRE, immediate remediation steps and customer notification within 2 hours
Post-pilot: synthesis doc with prioritized backlog and recommended ship timelines
risks: Latency regression in peak hours causing SLA breaches for lighthouse accounts
Incomplete release notes leading to missing configuration steps and customer confusion
Under-resourced Support during simultaneous enables across accounts
Legal/compliance hold delaying visible release notes or features for certain accounts
Insufficient telemetry causing delayed detection of subtle quality regressions
metrics_and_success_signals: Adoption: % of invited lighthouse accounts sending >= 50% of expected daily traffic (target >= 60%)
Quality: 95th percentile response latency for representative flows < 300ms
Feedback response SLA: 80% of tickets triaged within 5 business days
Conversion intent: >= 30% of lighthouse accounts express intent to purchase Dedicated or Private options
